notes: Dr. Mundo is a scaling juggernaut tank: weak levels 1-5 against most bruisers, a sustain spike at 6 (Maximum Dosage) and a real power spike from two HP items on, so level leads count less than for Jax and item/HP leads and game time count more. He has no burst, so the all-in bar is higher (e >= 2.5) and fighter/assassin lanes before 10 minutes get a penalty. After laning he side-lanes only while he clearly wins the 1v1 and no fed enemy can collapse; from 25 minutes he groups and walks in first as the front line.

motivation: Mundo goes where he pleases. Farm now, win later.
Throw cleavers, take CS, grow big. This lane is a waiting game.
Every HP item makes Mundo harder to kill. Be patient.
Don't fight early for pride. Mundo wins at two items.
Walk in first, soak everything, never stop walking.
Mundo says: good luck, have fun.
